values: 一名温柔坚毅的战士，擅长使用各种大剑剑技与敌人作战。
A gentle yet determined Warrior, masterful in the art of the greatsword.
Now I'm capable of protecting more people.
用这把剑，了结你的罪孽！
With this sword, you shall be purged!
I shall forever fight and protect.
嘿……嗬！还好，剑术没有生疏。
Ha...! Uh! Fortunately, my skills remain unblemished.
我的伙伴你还记得这道伤痕吗……
My friend, what scars we have now...
Hmm...? Oh, it's the sound of my heart.
这正是我需要的，你应该费了不少心吧，多谢。
This is precisely what I needed. I'm truly grateful for your efforts.
我已经很久没有收到礼物了……谢谢。
It's been an age since I last received a gift. Thank you.
巨剑沉重而锋利，因此才能守卫战乱中的无辜者。
The heavy and sharp greatsword keeps the innocent safe in war.
瓦丽卡身为人类时的战甲。存在与守护的信念，选择的即为真实。
The armor Valka wore when she was human. Have faith in yourself and trust your own judgment.
完成剧情任务“来自灵魂的选择”特定环节获得。
This place is as rowdy as a festival.
这副身躯也能感到暖意
This body can feel the warmth too.
The dawn will always break the longest night...
瓦勒沙家族和拉季诺夫家族的祖先，都曾是与瓦丽卡并肩作战的战友。
The ancestors of the Valesa and Radinov families were Valka's companions, and they fought alongside each other through many difficult battles.
因为亡灵的生命过于漫长，瓦丽卡特意拜访了一位魔法师，请对方为她的盔甲施加防止朽坏的魔法。
The Graveborn's lengthy existence prompted Valka to consult a specialized mage, asking him to enchant her armor to resist decay.
瓦丽卡非常喜欢自己的长发，每次出征前都会仔细地梳成长辫。但死而复生后，她已经没有心情打理自己了。
Valka had always cherished her long hair, meticulously braiding it before each battle. However, after her resurrection as a Graveborn, she no longer felt any desire to maintain her appearance.
尽管已经过去了上千年，但瓦丽卡仍然不习惯一低头就能看到心脏的感觉。
Despite the passage of thousands of years, Valka still hasn't grown accustomed to the unsettling sensation of being able to see her heart by simply looking down.
白山公国境内的亡灵都很敬重瓦丽卡。正是因为她的命令，亡灵大多生活在远离镇子的野外，很少靠近民居。
Valka is highly respected by all the Graveborn in the Duchy of Whiteridge. Her commands have led to most undead living in remote areas, seldom approaching human settlements.
在没人看得到的地方，瓦丽卡亲手清除了许多失控的活死人——他们大多是她曾经的战友。
In secret, Valka quietly dealt with numerous uncontrolled undead on her own. Sadly, the majority of those she had to destroy were her former comrades-in-arms.
瓦丽卡大部分时间都待在雪松镇和战场遗迹的交界地带，以防失控的活死人闯入镇子，造成不好的影响。
Most of Valka's time is spent at the border region between Cedartown and the old battlefield ruins, guarding against uncontrolled undead from entering the town and causing chaos.
每当瓦丽卡的一位战友失控变成活死人后，她就会为对方竖起墓碑。但随着时间流逝，那些墓碑早已破损风化，看不出原来的形状了。

Whenever one of Valka's comrades loses control and becomes an uncontrollable undead warrior, she would place a tombstone in their memory. However, over time, these tombstones have become damaged and weathered, their original forms unrecognizable.
为了警醒自己，瓦丽卡在死而复生后刻意没有修复破损的胸甲，而是将心脏外露。这种造型吓坏了不少初次见到她的人。

As a warning, Valka, after her return from death, chose not to repair her damaged breastplate, keeping her heart exposed. This striking appearance can be quite unsettling for those who encounter her for the first time.
雪松镇举办冬日祭典时，瓦丽卡会做好伪装，混入人群。只有这种时刻，她才能感受到自己并未彻底死去，而是以另一种方式“活着”。

At the Snowspire Festival in Cedartown, Valka would conceal her identity and blend into the crowd. It was the only time she could feel a glimmer of life, a reminder that she's not completely dead inside.
瓦丽卡？你刚才在温泉里泡了好久，我和梅林有点担心，温泉泡太久很容易头晕的。
Valka, is that you? You were in there so long that we got a bit worried. Soaking too long can make you dizzy.
漫漫 & 瓦丽卡 & 满满
无论来这里多少次，我都还是会被这样的美景所震撼。大片的花，掩映在花丛中的古老遗迹，清澈的河水，远处的雪山……

The scenery here never fails to enchant me, no matter how many times I've visited—the sea of flowers, the ancient ruins hidden among them, the clear water, and the snow-capped mountains in the distance...
寒冷、肃穆、嘈杂和寂静的完美结合……白山的冬天总是会让我想起第一次神魔战争的时候。
The perfect combination of cold, solemnity, clamor, and silence... Winters in Whiteridge always bring me back to the First Divine War.
满满，你为什么用这么奇怪的眼神看着我的武器？
Chippy, why are you staring at my weapon like that?
看好了，先用劈砍或者刺击敌人逼对方闪躲，然后让过剑锋，反转长剑，近身用剑柄攻击手腕……像这样！
Remember to start with slashes and thrusts, forcing your opponent to dodge. Then, reverse your sword and aim at your opponent's wrist with the hilt... like this!
伊戈尔？可算找到你了，你怎么跑到这里来了？
Igor. There you are. What are you doing here?
缤纷的焰火，华丽的灯光……每到春焰庆，连黑夜都会暂时消退啊。
The vibrant fireworks, the brilliant lights... Every Emberlight Festival, it feels as though even the night itself takes a step back for a while.
这副身躯也能感到暖意
This body can feel the warmth too.
The dawn will always break the longest night...
晚上好，女士。这里难得有空位，介意与我分享这张桌子吗？
Good evening, milady. There don't seem to be many open seats. May I join you?
